message.content: {"skills": [{"name": "Incident Effect Application During Resolution Phase", "description": "Applies active incident effects to edges during the Incident Resolution Phase of each tick, honoring StartTick/EndTick windows and reverting to baseline when expired. Use when advancing simulation ticks with active or scheduled incidents.", "prompt": "During the Incident Resolution Phase of tick t, for each incident evaluate whether StartTick <= t < EndTick. If active, apply its effect to the affected edge: for CLOSE_EDGE, block new vehicle entry while allowing vehicles already on the edge to continue; for REDUCE_CAPACITY, apply the CapacityMultiplier to the edge capacity. If t >= EndTick, revert the edge to its baseline attributes unless another active incident modifies it. Update edge attributes accordingly and report the resulting state.", "asset_type": "session_skill", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "granularity": "session", "objective": "Correctly apply and expire incident effects on edges per tick.", "domain": "traffic simulation", "task_family": "incident_handling", "method_family": "rule_based_tick_update", "stage": "incident_resolution_phase", "applicable_signals": ["Active or scheduled incidents present at current tick", "Tick equals an incident StartTick or reaches EndTick"], "intervention_moves": ["Check StartTick <= t < EndTick for each incident", "Apply CLOSE_EDGE by blocking new entries while allowing on-edge vehicles to continue", "Apply REDUCE_CAPACITY by scaling edge capacity with CapacityMultiplier", "Revert edge to baseline when t >= EndTick unless another active incident applies"], "contraindications": ["No incidents are defined or active", "Outside the Incident Resolution Phase"], "triggers": ["A tick is being processed and incidents exist", "An incident's StartTick or EndTick boundary is reached"], "workflow_steps": ["Identify all incidents affecting edges at tick t.", "For each incident, test whether StartTick <= t < EndTick.", "If active, apply the effect: CLOSE_EDGE blocks new entries (existing on-edge vehicles continue); REDUCE_CAPACITY scales capacity by CapacityMultiplier.", "If t >= EndTick, revert the edge to baseline attributes unless another active incident modifies it.", "Record updated edge attributes for the tick."], "constraints": ["EndTick is exclusive.", "CapacityMultiplier must be in (0,1].", "CLOSE_EDGE does not stop vehicles already on the edge."], "cautions": ["Multiple incidents may affect the same edge; baseline reversion applies only if no other active incident modifies it."], "output_contract": ["Edge attributes updated to reflect active incidents or reverted to baseline."], "examples": [{"input": "Tick t within [StartTick, EndTick) for a REDUCE_CAPACITY incident with CapacityMultiplier 0.5 on an edge.", "output": "Edge capacity scaled to 50% of baseline for that tick.", "notes": "Effect applied during Incident Resolution Phase."}, {"input": "Tick t >= EndTick for a CLOSE_EDGE incident with no other active incident on the edge.", "output": "Edge reverted to baseline attributes;
